bookingOpens: Online on the restaurant's website (the booking form appears after accepting cookies), by phone or by email to ligalli@villafrancahotel.it. Dinner only, every day, 7.30pm to 10.30pm, for seven tables. A card is charged €150 per person when booking; this is the minimum spend and comes off the final bill. Parties of up to 3 must order at least three courses each from the à la carte menu.
cancellation: Cancellations are accepted only in writing, at least 48 hours ahead; later cancellations and no-shows lose the €150 per person paid when booking. A table may not be kept for guests more than 15 minutes late.
dressCode: Smart casual. Men must wear trousers and closed shoes; no flip-flops or sandals.
children: Children aged 8 and over are welcome (one part of the booking page says over 10). Pets are not allowed.
byob: Outside food and wine are not allowed.
